notes: This map is the machine-readable contract for fingerprint/IP privacy governance.
Retention is enforced by Mongo TTL indexes, scheduled cleanup jobs, or documented manual admin actions.
User account deletion currently removes the user_datas document; linked fingerprint/IP telemetry cleanup is tracked as a long-term debt item.

proxycheck-* datasets were added 2026-09-25 with the proxycheck.io IP-risk integration. The risk cache is TTL-bounded; the lookup-log and probe-report collections are read-only superadmin surfaces and still await a retention job (declared as an acknowledged gap). The lookup log additionally stores the decision handed to the caller.

policy_consents gained documentHash (which text revision was accepted) plus revokedAt/revokedIP/revokedReason (withdrawal audit trail) on 2026-09-30, and an owner-initiated hard delete via POST /api/policy/revoke {purge:true}. A superadmin CSV export (/api/admin/policy-consents/export) is the only bulk surface; it is audited and row-capped.

2026-10-03: audit_logs TTL narrowed 90d -> 60d (AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS in src/models/auditLogModel.ts). Existing deployments must run `ts-node src/scripts/applyAuditLogTtl.ts` to change the live index in place — editing the schema alone does not update an existing TTL index.

2026-10-03: every dataset now carries a userFacing block (Chinese label / category / what / why / retention + the policy section that explains it). The privacy policy page renders that block through src/generated/privacyDataMap.ts, so the page cannot drift from this contract; `pnpm run check:privacy-data-map` enforces the generated file in CI.

Integration datasets added 2026-10-02: email_suppressions (bounce/complaint/unsubscribe suppression list, email address only, written by the Resend webhook, the public unsubscribe link, or a superadmin), recommendation_feedback (explicit like/dislike per user+style), and webhook_events (third-party webhook payloads; superadmin-only reads and a manual retention prune). All three are reachable from the integration health center (/admin/integrations).

datasets.purpose: Account risk control, fingerprint request UX, and abnormal login review

userFacing.label: 账户设备指纹与最近登录
userFacing.what: 设备指纹 ID、上报时间、浏览器/客户端 UA、上报时的 IP、设备特征摘要；以及最近登录 IP 与时间、「要求下次登录上报指纹」的状态。
userFacing.why: 识别异常登录、设备变更与账号共享；支撑「下次登录必须上报指纹」这类账户安全操作，并用于风控复核。
userFacing.retention: 随账户保存；删除账户或由管理员清空指纹记录时移除（含最近登录 IP/时间）。

retention.description: Stored with the account until the account is deleted or an admin clears fingerprints

delete.gap: Does not cascade into anonymous TTS or temporary fingerprint collections

export.surface: admin user export / profile admin views

datasets.purpose: First-visit and anonymous access verification

userFacing.label: 临时设备指纹（首访验证）
userFacing.what: 指纹值、IP、是否已通过验证、过期时间。
userFacing.why: 首次访问与匿名访问的人机验证，用于判断该来源是否可信、是否需要额外验证。
userFacing.retention: 按各自过期时间由数据库自动清理（通常 5 分钟到 24 小时）；管理员也可手动清理过期记录。

retention.description: Documents set expiresAt and are removed by Mongo TTL

export.reason: Ephemeral security signal; not part of user data export

datasets.purpose: Short-lived access binding for verification flows

userFacing.label: 短期访问令牌
userFacing.what: 令牌值、绑定的指纹、IP、过期时间。
userFacing.why: 验证流程中的短时访问绑定，避免「验证一次即可无限复用」。
userFacing.retention: 数分钟内到期，由数据库自动清理。

datasets.purpose: IP challenge state for Turnstile/hCaptcha flows

userFacing.label: IP 验证令牌
userFacing.what: 令牌、绑定指纹、IP、签发方、是否完成挑战、风险分与风险标记、过期时间。
userFacing.why: 首访 IP 验证与人机验证的挑战状态记录，决定该来源是否需要额外验证。
userFacing.retention: 数分钟到数小时自动过期。

datasets.purpose: Abuse enforcement and rate-limit escalation

userFacing.label: IP 封禁记录
userFacing.what: IP 或网段、封禁原因、违规次数、封禁与到期时间、关联指纹与 UA。
userFacing.why: 滥用处置与限流升级：封禁针对来源而非个人，用于阻断持续攻击、爬取与批量滥用。
userFacing.retention: 保留至封禁到期（数据库自动清理）；管理员可随时解除。

delete.reason: Security enforcement may outlive an individual account

datasets.purpose: Proof of policy acceptance: the four agreements ticked at login/register, an explicit acceptance for gated features such as anonymous TTS, or a server-signed record refreshed at either point (source, agreements). documentHash pins which text revision was accepted; revokedAt/revokedIP record a withdrawal.

userFacing.label: 政策同意记录
userFacing.what: 设备指纹、IP、UA、条文版本与条文指纹、勾选的文件清单、来源（登录/注册/匿名功能签发）、签发与到期时间；撤回时记录撤回时间、IP 与原因。
userFacing.why: 证明你在哪一版条文下同意过哪些文件，以及撤回同意的留痕——这是双方都需要的凭据。
userFacing.retention: 默认 30 天有效（部署可配置 1–3650 天），到期由数据库自动回收；可在本设备自助撤回并要求删除本设备记录。

delete.userAction: POST /api/policy/revoke (body { purge: true } hard-deletes this device's records and clears the device credential cookie)

export.surface: GET /api/policy/status (device owner), admin stats, superadmin /api/admin/policy-consents (+ /export CSV, superadmin only, audited)

datasets.purpose: Job ownership, abuse detection, queue recovery, and result delivery

userFacing.label: 文字转语音任务
userFacing.what: 任务号、发起用户、发起 IP、指纹、请求参数（文本、音色、语速等）、状态与结果音频位置、时间。
userFacing.why: 生成音频、交付结果、任务队列恢复与故障排查，以及滥用排查。
userFacing.retention: 目前无自动过期（为支持队列恢复与人工支持而保留）；账户删除后的历史任务清理仍在补齐。

retention.description: No TTL today; retained for queue recovery and support. Long-term deletion job is outstanding debt.

delete.current: userId remains on historical jobs; account document is removed separately
delete.target: delete or de-identify jobs for deleted users

datasets.purpose: Security and admin accountability

userFacing.label: 管理操作审计日志
userFacing.what: 操作者 ID/用户名/角色、动作、模块、IP、UA、请求路径与方法、结果与细节、时间。
userFacing.why: 安全审计与管理问责：记录「谁在什么时间以什么身份做了什么管理动作」，用于安全事件复盘。
userFacing.retention: 保留 60 天，到期由数据库 TTL 自动清理（2026-10-03 起由 90 天收窄为 60 天）。

delete.reason: Audit integrity may require short retention after account removal

datasets.purpose: Behavioral risk scoring and abuse analytics

userFacing.label: 行为数据采集
userFacing.what: 用户 ID、行为动作、时间、明细、风险分与风险等级、分析结论、校验值。
userFacing.why: 风控评分与滥用分析：识别异常行为模式（例如批量注册、异常调用节奏）。
userFacing.retention: 默认不设自动过期；部署可通过 DATA_COLLECTION_TTL_DAYS 打开 TTL。账户删除后的级联清理仍在补齐。

retention.description: TTL is optional and disabled unless DATA_COLLECTION_TTL_DAYS is set

delete.target: delete or anonymize rows for deleted userId

datasets.purpose: Mobile/device integrity signals for NexAI and related clients

userFacing.label: 设备风险跟踪
userFacing.what: 用户 ID、设备指纹、风险分与等级、IP、UA、首次与最近出现时间。
userFacing.why: 移动端与其它客户端的设备完整性判断（如 NexAI 相关客户端），用于识别设备被替换或批量伪造。
userFacing.retention: 按账户生命周期保留（目前无自动过期）；账户删除后的级联清理仍在补齐。

retention.description: No TTL today; intended lifetime is account lifetime plus short security hold

delete.target: delete by userId when account is deleted

export.reason: Security telemetry; export only via admin investigation tooling

datasets.purpose: Third-party IP reputation decision audit

userFacing.label: 第三方 IP 风险查询日志
userFacing.what: IP、指纹、UA、判定结果、欺诈分与第三方原始响应、时间。
userFacing.why: 记录一次 IP 风险判定「是怎么得出的」，便于事后复核与误判申诉。
userFacing.retention: 目前无自动过期（建议 30–90 天，清理任务待补）。

retention.description: No TTL today; should be capped (recommended 30-90d) in a follow-up cleanup job

export.reason: May contain third-party raw responses and should not be user-exported

datasets.purpose: Client-side fingerprint cache and report debounce

userFacing.label: 浏览器本地指纹缓存
userFacing.what: 保存在你自己浏览器里的指纹值、随机种子、最近一次上报去重信息。
userFacing.why: 减少重复上报与重复验证，让同一设备的验证结果稳定。
userFacing.retention: 本地缓存 30 天；清除站点数据会一并清除，登出不会自动清除。

delete.userAction: clear site data / logout does not currently wipe fingerprint cache

datasets.purpose: Front-end tamper/injection detection and the per-IP auto-ban decision (10 events per hour)

userFacing.label: 防篡改事件
userFacing.what: 事件 ID、时间、页面地址、IP、UA、事件与篡改类型、检测方式、被篡改内容片段、文件路径、校验值、严重级别、过期时间。
userFacing.why: 检测前端页面被注入或篡改，并据此对同一来源自动封禁（同一 IP 一小时内 10 次事件）。
userFacing.retention: 默认保留 30 天（部署可配置 1–365 天），到期由数据库自动清理。

retention.description: Each document carries an absolute expiresAt written at insert; Mongo TTL reclaims it. Documents written before this field existed are never reclaimed.

delete.gap: Not keyed by user id, so an account deletion cannot cascade into events recorded for that user's IP

export.reason: Security telemetry, not part of user data export

datasets.purpose: Per-IP proxycheck.io reputation cache that also de-duplicates upstream lookups (one upstream request per IP per TTL window); read-only in the superadmin IP-risk log panel, which shows the current-threshold verdict each row would produce

userFacing.label: IP 风险缓存
userFacing.what: IP 及其代理/VPN/Tor/机房/爬虫标记、置信度、网络与地理信息（国家、城市、时区等）。
userFacing.why: 缓存第三方 IP 信誉结果、合并同一 IP 的重复查询；管理员只读面板据此展示当前阈值下的判定。
userFacing.retention: 按缓存有效期自动过期（默认 24 小时，可由管理员配置 1–168 小时）。

retention.description: expiresAt is written on every upsert as queriedAt + cacheTtlHours; Mongo TTL reclaims the document, which is also what makes a later request hit the upstream again.

delete.patched: An admin disabling PROXYCHECK stops new upstream calls; cached rows age out on their own TTL
delete.gap: Not keyed by user id, so account deletion cannot cascade into rows recorded for that user's IP

export.reason: Third-party reputation data keyed by IP, not part of user data export; also exposed read-only to superadmins through /api/admin/proxycheck/risk-cache

datasets.purpose: Third-party IP reputation decision audit and daily-quota accounting; never stores the raw proxycheck.io response. The decision sub-document records the exact verdict handed to the caller (which frontend path asked, the action taken, the reason, the threshold and fail-open setting in force)

userFacing.label: IP 风险查询台账
userFacing.what: IP、使用的密钥槽与密钥哈希、状态与耗时、风险分、是否命中缓存，以及交给调用方的判定结论与采取的动作。
userFacing.why: 记录一次访问被放行/挑战/拒绝的依据，用于排障与误判申诉复核。
userFacing.retention: 目前无自动过期（建议 30–90 天，清理任务待补）。

retention.description: No TTL today; readable by the superadmin IP-risk log panel (/admin/ip-risk-logs), which added a {createdAt:-1} index for newest-first paging. Still should be capped (recommended 30-90d) in a follow-up cleanup job

export.reason: Security telemetry, not part of user data export; also exposed read-only to superadmins through /api/admin/proxycheck/lookups

datasets.purpose: Client-reported network-exit / IPv6-exit / WebSocket-leak telemetry used to detect VPN, proxy and split-tunnel exits that contradict the observed HTTP origin

userFacing.label: 网络出口探测上报
userFacing.what: 上报 IP、HTTP/WebSocket 出口 IP、IPv6 出口、WebRTC 泄漏、时区与语言、UA 与平台、CPU 核数/内存、屏幕分辨率、是否自动化、上报时间与判定标记。
userFacing.why: 识别 VPN、代理与分流泄漏（客户端声明的出口与实际出口不一致）。
userFacing.retention: 目前无自动过期（清理任务待补）。

retention.description: No TTL today; readable by the superadmin IP-risk log panel (/admin/ip-risk-logs), which added a {createdAt:-1} index for newest-first paging. Still should be capped in a follow-up cleanup job

delete.gap: Client-reported browser fingerprint fields (timezone, languages, screen, WebRTC) are stored against the reporting IP; there is no per-user erasure path for pseudonymous reports

export.reason: Anti-abuse telemetry, not part of user data export; also exposed read-only to superadmins through /api/admin/proxycheck/probe-reports

datasets.purpose: Rotating long-lived client login tokens (sml_) for mobile clients: only the SHA-256 hash of the token is stored, plus the device binding and the rotation lineage that lets a leaked token family be revoked as a unit. `reusedAt`/`reusedIp` mark the superseded generation whose replay tripped the lineage revocation, for the admin lineage board

userFacing.label: 移动端长期登录令牌
userFacing.what: 令牌哈希（不保存明文）、用户 ID、设备 ID 与名称、签发/到期/最近使用时间与最近使用 IP、轮换血缘、撤销时间、设备指纹。
userFacing.why: 移动端长期登录（sml_ 令牌）与按设备撤销、按血缘整体吊销：令牌泄露时可让整条链失效。
userFacing.retention: 每代令牌 90 天，到期由数据库自动清理；已轮换超过 30 天的常规 IP 字段会被定期清除。

retention.description: Mongo TTL index on ttlExpireAt drops the document once the generation expires; rotation only marks the previous generation superseded (it does not set revokedAt), and replaying that generation after the grace window revokes the whole lineage. Field-level retention is shorter for the routine IP fields: a generation that has been superseded for more than 30 days has lastUsedIp/rotatedIp unset by a periodic sweep, while reusedIp is kept as the incident record for the reuse board

delete.automatic: Mongo TTL on ttlExpireAt; admin user deletion and password reset call revokeAllAuthSessions(), which revokes these tokens by clientTokenHash
delete.gap: Superseded generations keep their lastUsedIp / rotatedIp rows until TTL expiry; there is no shorter security-hold job

export.reason: Security telemetry keyed by token hash; the token itself is not recoverable from the stored hash

datasets.purpose: Bilibili login cookies a client files immediately after a Bilibili login completes, archived per (clientId, deviceId, UID) so the operator can see which device holds which session. The cookie is only ever stored as AES-GCM ciphertext; the device snapshot and granted-permission list are non-secret metadata.

userFacing.label: B 站登录凭据上报
userFacing.what: 设备 id、B 站 UID、客户端信息、登录凭据密文（仅密文，任何界面都不会导出明文）、上报次数与时间。
userFacing.why: 在你授权的前提下，把 PiliPlus 的 B 站登录状态存档到服务端，供账号绑定与跨设备同步使用。
userFacing.retention: 同一设备与账号的新记录会替换旧记录，保留至被替换或由管理员删除（无自动过期）。

retention.description: Kept until the report is replaced by a newer one from the same device or deleted by an operator; there is no TTL today. Rows are keyed by device id, not by Synapse account, because the reporter holds no Synapse session.

delete.current: no user cascade: rows belong to a (clientId, deviceId, bilibiliUid) triple rather than to a Synapse userId
delete.gap: a device that uninstalls the app leaves its last report behind until an operator deletes it

export.reason: Admin listing returns metadata only; ciphertext fields are select:false and the plaintext cookie is never serialized into a response

datasets.purpose: Suppression list that stops outbound mail to addresses that hard-bounced, complained, or unsubscribed. Written by the Resend webhook handler, the public unsubscribe link (HMAC token), and superadmins.

userFacing.label: 邮件抑制名单
userFacing.what: 邮箱地址、抑制原因（退信/投诉/退订）与时间。
userFacing.why: 避免继续向已退信或已投诉的地址发信——这既是对方意愿，也是发信信誉的要求。
userFacing.retention: 退订与投诉永久保留；软退信按 30 天窗口保留。仅超级管理员可移除。

retention.description: Unsubscribes and complaints are permanent; soft bounces carry a 30-day expiry. Rows are only removed by a superadmin, because forgetting a suppression silently resumes mailing an address that opted out.

delete.current: keyed by recipient address rather than a Synapse account, so an account deletion cannot cascade

export.surface: GET /api/admin/integrations/email-suppressions (superadmin only; returns the address, reason, source and timestamps)

datasets.purpose: Explicit like / dislike / not-interested signals per user and voice style, used to filter and rank TTS style recommendations.

userFacing.label: 推荐反馈
userFacing.what: 用户 ID、音色/风格 ID、喜欢或不喜欢（可附备注）、时间。
userFacing.why: 个性化推荐：记住你对音色与风格的偏好，用于排序与过滤。
userFacing.retention: 随账户保存，账户删除时一并删除。

retention.description: Kept while the account exists so the preference keeps applying; one row per (userId, styleId).

delete.current: rows carry userId and would need to be removed by an account-deletion cascade (tracked as a gap, same class as recommendation_history)
delete.manual: no admin surface today; a user can overwrite their own latest feedback through POST /api/recommendations/feedback

datasets.purpose: Inbound third-party webhook deliveries (Resend/Svix) for deliverability monitoring and incident forensics. `raw`/`data` are verbatim provider payloads and may contain recipient addresses.

userFacing.label: 第三方 Webhook 事件
userFacing.what: 事件 ID、来源、类型、状态、第三方原始 payload（可能包含收件人邮箱、邮件主题与正文片段）、时间与投递次数。
userFacing.why: 排查第三方回调（例如邮件投递与退信状态）与失败重放。
userFacing.retention: 无自动过期；超级管理员可执行清理（默认保留 90 天，先预览再删除）。

retention.description: No TTL; a superadmin prune keeps a configurable number of days (default 90) and runs as a dry-run first. Until an operator runs it, events are retained indefinitely.

delete.current: keyed by provider event id, not by Synapse account
delete.manual: POST /api/admin/integrations/webhooks/prune (superadmin + audit log; dryRun by default)

export.surface: GET /api/webhook-events (superadmin only; the list and detail endpoints are intentionally superadmin-gated because raw payloads carry third-party data)
